simple.meaning: תַּחֲנִי (Tachănîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Tachanite (collectively) or descendants of Tachan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּחֲנִי (H8470) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּחֲנִי (H8470) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּחֲנִי (Tachănîy) / H8470 is traced through Numbers 26:35 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Tachanite (collectively) or descendants of Tachan
definitions.full: H8470. Tachani תַּחֲנִי adjective, of a people only with article as substantive collective, ׳הַתּ Num 26:35 . [ תִּימָרָה ] noun feminine (palm-like) column (spreading at top; compare Ol § 184 b ); — plural construct עָשָׁן תִּימְרוֺת Joel 3:2 ; Song 3:6 (compare עָשָׁן עַמּוּד in prose Judg 20:40 ).

occurrences.englishText: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
